Stage 3 · Grammar

Grammar

What…? · Where…? · Why…?
Question wordAsks aboutExample
WhatthingWhat do you do?
Where / Whenplace / timeWhere do you live?
Who / Whyperson / reasonWhy do you like it?
How many / muchnumber / priceHow much is it?
  • Wh- word + do/does + subject + verb: Where do you live? What does she do?
  • What = thing · Where = place · When = time · Who = person · Why = reason · How = way.
  • How many + plural (How many books?) · How much + price (How much is it?).
  • Answer with the information: Where…? — In London. When…? — At seven. Why…? — Because…

→ can (I can swim) comes next.

Stage 6 · Speaking

Your turn

Write two Wh- questions: Where …? / What …? / Why …? .

When you finish, open the model answer and check yourself.

Model answer

Where do you live? What's your favourite building? Why do you like it? How often do you go there?

Check yourself:

  • Did you start with a Wh- word (Where, What, Why)?
  • Did you use do / does (Where do you…?)?
  • Does the word match (Where→place, When→time)?
Talk to Sam. Answer with the words from this lesson.

Read each message. Tap 🔊 to hear Sam.

Sam

Sam

Why

Wh- questions need do/does: Where DO you live? What DOES she do?

Sam

Feedback
